title: Winter sun from East Midlands in February: direct flights compared
author: Matt
intro: East Midlands Airport has a good spread of winter sun flights with Jet2, Ryanair and TUI, and February half term is the week most families want them. Here's where you can fly direct in February, how long it takes and how warm each place usually is.
seo_title: Winter sun from East Midlands in February: 2½ to 4 hrs
seo_description: The Canaries are about 4 hours from East Midlands and 21-22°C in February. Agadir is new this winter; Málaga and Faro are closer. Every option compared.

sections.heading: The short answer
sections.text:
- **Warm and easy:** the Canaries, 4 hrs
- **New this winter:** Jet2 to Agadir
- **Shortest flight:** Málaga or Faro
- **Half term:** 15 to 19 Feb 2027

The temperatures are average February daytime highs from the climate figures in our guides. Flight times are typical direct times from East Midlands. We checked the routes in October and November 2026, but timetables and flying days change, so check the airline's own schedule for your dates before you book.

sections.heading: All the options compared
sections.text:
| Place | Flight from East Midlands | February high | Time difference |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Málaga](/destinations/malaga) | about 2½ hrs | 18°C | +1 hr |
| [The Algarve](/destinations/algarve) (Faro) | about 2½ hrs | 17°C | none |
| [Agadir](/destinations/agadir) | about 3¾ hrs | 21°C | 0 to +1 hr |
| [Tenerife](/destinations/tenerife) | about 4¼ hrs | 22°C | none |
| [Gran Canaria](/destinations/gran-canaria) | about 4¼ hrs | 22°C | none |
| [Lanzarote](/destinations/lanzarote) | about 4 hrs | 22°C | none |
| [Fuerteventura](/destinations/fuerteventura) | about 4 hrs | 21°C | none |

Alicante is another short, mild option, about two and a half hours away. Morocco is normally an hour ahead of the UK, but it puts its clocks back for Ramadan, which is expected to start in early February 2027, so it's likely to be on UK time for much of the month.

There are no regular long-haul winter sun flights from East Midlands. For Dubai, the Red Sea or the Caribbean, Birmingham and Manchester are the nearest airports with more choice.

sections.heading: The Canaries: the easy choice
sections.text:
Between them, Jet2, Ryanair and TUI fly from East Midlands to all four main Canary Islands, and they're the warmest beach weather in Europe in February, at about 21 to 22°C by day. They're on UK time, so there's no jet lag.

- **[Tenerife](/destinations/tenerife) and [Gran Canaria](/destinations/gran-canaria):** the most to do, with the sunniest resorts in the south of each island.
- **[Lanzarote](/destinations/lanzarote):** calmer, with volcanic scenery and low white villages.
- **[Fuerteventura](/destinations/fuerteventura):** long sandy beaches, though it's often windy.

February is carnival month too, with big parades in Santa Cruz de Tenerife and Las Palmas de Gran Canaria. Our [Lanzarote or Fuerteventura](/blog/lanzarote-or-fuerteventura) and [Gran Canaria or Tenerife](/blog/gran-canaria-or-tenerife) posts help you choose an island.

sections.heading: Agadir: new this winter
sections.text:
Jet2 has added a weekly flight from East Midlands to [Agadir](/destinations/agadir) in Morocco for winter 2026/27, running from November to March. At about 21°C in February, it's almost as warm as the Canaries, with a long sandy beach, a seafront promenade and good-value all-inclusive hotels.

It's a taste of Morocco too, with the souk, the hilltop kasbah reached by cable car, and day trips into the Atlas foothills. Our [Agadir or Tenerife in winter](/blog/agadir-or-tenerife-in-winter) post compares it with the Canaries. Ramadan is expected to cover much of February 2027. Hotels carry on as normal, but some cafés outside them close in the day, and it's polite not to eat or drink in the street before sunset.

sections.heading: Shorter flights: Málaga and the Algarve
sections.text:
- **[Málaga](/destinations/malaga):** about 18°C in February, and a proper city, with the Picasso Museum, tapas bars and day trips to Granada and the white villages.
- **[The Algarve](/destinations/algarve):** about 17°C, quiet in winter, and good for clifftop walks and golf, with no time difference.

Watch out: these are mild, not hot, in February. Expect jumper weather in the evenings, and don't count on swimming in the sea. Our [Algarve or Málaga in winter](/blog/algarve-or-malaga-in-winter) post compares the two.

sections.heading: February half term from East Midlands
sections.text:
Nottinghamshire County Council schools have February half term from 15 to 19 February 2027, and Leicestershire and Derby schools are listed for the same week. Academies and other councils can set different dates, so check with your school.

- **For the best prices:** go in the first two weeks of February, or the week after half term.
- **For a short break:** Málaga or Faro for three or four nights.
- **For a week of reliable warmth:** the south of Tenerife or Gran Canaria, or Agadir.

Tip: Agadir and some of the Canary Islands only have one or two flights a week from East Midlands in winter. Check the flying days before you fix your dates.

Our [February half term](/destinations/february-half-term-holidays) page has more ideas, and [where to go in February](/destinations/where-to-go-in-february) covers the whole month.

sections.heading: Where could you go from East Midlands?
sections.text:
Start with [Tenerife](/destinations/tenerife) or [Lanzarote](/destinations/lanzarote) for an easy week, or [Agadir](/destinations/agadir) for something new. Our guide to [where you can fly direct from East Midlands](/blog/where-can-you-fly-direct-from-east-midlands-airport) lists every route, including city breaks, and [how early to arrive at East Midlands Airport](/blog/how-early-should-you-arrive-at-east-midlands-airport) helps with the early start.

Can't agree? Add your favourites to somewhere.party, give everyone points to vote with, and let the draw choose.

faqs.question: Where is warmest in February with a direct flight from East Midlands?
faqs.answer: The Canaries, at about 21 to 22°C, with Agadir in Morocco close behind at about 21°C. Both are around four hours away.

faqs.question: How long is the flight from East Midlands to Tenerife?
faqs.answer: About four and a quarter hours direct. Lanzarote and Fuerteventura are slightly shorter.

faqs.question: When is February half term 2027 in the East Midlands?
faqs.answer: Nottinghamshire County Council schools are off from 15 to 19 February 2027, and Leicestershire and Derby schools are listed for the same week. Check with your school, as academies can differ.

faqs.question: Can you fly long-haul from East Midlands in winter?
faqs.answer: There are no regular long-haul winter sun routes. For Dubai, the Red Sea or the Caribbean, Birmingham and Manchester have more direct flights.
